Participants and recorder: fictional project roles only. No meeting took place.

Dear project team, these are the additional case-backed answers for this simulated drafting exercise. Please retain their scope and source qualifications.

Project in Tin Shui Wai

Project in Tin Shui Wai: No

Case-derived negative location: explicit project identity is Tung Chung Area 98, not a default from the standard template.

Roofing installation included

Roofing installation included: Yes

Roofing and associated waterproofing systems are actual project items within design responsibility and the specified warranty scope.

Roofing warranty required

Roofing warranty required: Yes

Actual case SCC7.304 expressly warrants the roofing installation for ten years.

Other waterproofing warranty required

Other waterproofing warranty required: Yes

Actual case SCC7.304 expressly warrants other specified waterproofing installations; the PRE enumerates the areas.

Other waterproofing areas specified in Specification

Other waterproofing areas specified in Specification: 1.Kitchens;

2.Bathrooms, toilets, lavatories;

3.Refuse storage and material recovery rooms (RS&MRR), refuse storage and material recovery chambers (RS&MRC), refuse collection points (RCP), refuse storage and Junk Collection Points (JCP);

4.Lift pits, sump pits and lift pit floors;

5. External tankings of maintenance access for lift pits;

6.External tankings of car park and car ramp connecting to car park;

7.Internal tankings;

8.Planters and landscaped decks at podium floors (including zero irrigation system planters), podium garden, structures associated with vertical greening and green roof;

9.All roof areas over domestic flats and non-domestic premises (including green roofs, flat roofs, main roofs, upper roofs, canopies, covered walkways, podium deck, dog houses, smoke vents and duct shafts etc.);

10. Water pump rooms, associated drain pits and water meter rooms / cabinet / cupboards;

11.Fresh, flush and fire services water pump rooms and associated drain pits for overflow pipes, master water meter rooms, water meter rooms, electrical plant / services rooms adjacent to water meter rooms / cabinets / water pump rooms;

12.Suspended manholes and suspended cable trenches / chambers and draw pits;

13.G/F level slabs;

14.Walls of pipe ducts and water pump rooms adjoining transformer rooms, electrical meter/ switch rooms, TBE Room, emergency generator room and electrical plant rooms;

15.Services platform for pipework installation above common areas, back of house, service corridors, plant rooms, domestic and non-domestic area;

16.Service platform for Building Services installation such as fans, air conditioners and pipeworks etc.;

17.Potable, flushing and fire services pump rooms, including associated drain pits for overflow pipes; and

18. All areas with waterproofing membranes, waterproofing layers or waterproofing systems.

Full 18 area list copied from PRE.B6.590; retain actual numbering, wording and catch-all item 18.

Acrylic paint warranty required

Acrylic paint warranty required: Yes

Actual case SCC7.305 contains the seven-year warranty; this records an adopted project provision.

Wall tiling warranty required

Wall tiling warranty required: Yes

Actual case SCC7.306 warrants Wall Tiling Works; period is five years commencing two years after completion, not an invented immediately-starting warranty.

Play equipment included

Play equipment included: Yes

Actual case SCC requires design, supply and installation of play equipment, and PRE includes play/fitness equipment in the material scope.

IASM included

IASM included: Yes

Actual case requires IASM design/supply/installation; PRE identifies EXT10 IASM and associated works.

Epoxy coated cast iron pipes / fittings warranty required

Epoxy coated cast iron pipes / fittings warranty required: Yes

Actual case SCC7.308 unconditionally warrants material/workmanship of epoxy-coated cast iron pipework; start/duration distinctions remain in the quote.

The checked case does not separately establish the refuge-floor installation branch. An absent statement is not No. The areas of other waterproofing above are retained in full, including the catch-all eighteenth item.
